programmes.name_en: Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment (MBRHE) Dubai
programmes.amount_note: Residential plots, government houses, ready houses, maintenance/extension grants and housing loans for Dubai nationals; amount per policy.

programmes.name_en: Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme
programmes.amount_note: Monthly salary top-up for Emiratis in private-sector roles, tiered by qualification (historically up to AED 7,000-8,000/month for up to 5 years); bands revised from September 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Nafis platform as a jobseeker or employee

eligibility.income_note: Top-up applies to private-sector salaries below the public-sector benchmark

programmes.source_snippet: Salary support: monthly top-up to the Emirati employee's salary for a defined period (commonly five years).

programmes.name_en: Nafis Child Allowance Scheme
programmes.amount_note: Official Nafis page excerpt: below AED 50,000 monthly salary, AED 600 per month per eligible child. Earlier AED 800 figure (and 'no cap on children' reform) comes from news, not an official page reachable today; confirm on nafis.gov.ae.

eligibility.income_note: For Emiratis earning below AED 50,000 per month in the private sector

programmes.source_snippet: Below AED 50,000 per month, AED 600 per month for each eligible ...

programmes.name_en: Nafis Unemployment Support for Emiratis
programmes.amount_note: Time-limited benefit for Emiratis who lose private-sector jobs involuntarily: AED 7,000/month for the unemployed person (AED 4,500 unemployed spouse, up to AED 3,000 per child), subject to active job search.
programmes.source_snippet: An unemployed Emirati receives AED 7,000 per month; their unemployed spouse receives AED 4,500; eligible children receive up to AED 3,000.

programmes.name_en: Nafis Pension Contribution Support
programmes.amount_note: Government subsidy of GPSSA pension contributions for Emirati private-sector employees, closing the public-private pension gap.
programmes.source_snippet: GPSSA pension contribution: federal contribution to the General Pension and Social Security Authority scheme, equivalent to the employer contribution.

programmes.name_en: Nafis Training and Apprenticeship Support
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised accredited training and apprenticeship salary support for Emiratis entering private-sector roles.
programmes.source_snippet: On-the-job training support and apprenticeship support for young Emiratis and recent graduates.

programmes.name_local: معاش التقاعد - الهيئة العامة للمعاشات والتأمينات الاجتماعية
programmes.name_en: GPSSA Retirement Pension for Emiratis
programmes.funder: General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly pension based on average contribution salary and years of service (2.67% per year of service under the 2023 law); GPSSA guarantees a minimum monthly pension of AED 10,000.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: An Emirati national is entitled to a pension if he/she as an insured person reaches retirement age of 60 years and completes an insured service period of 15 years.

programmes.name_en: GPSSA Disability and Survivor Benefits
programmes.funder: General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA)
programmes.amount_note: Work-related total disability or death: pension calculated as if 35 years of service (100% of average pension-account salary); total disability also receives AED 75,000 compensation (partial disability pro-rata). Survivor shares: widow(s)/eligible husband 37.5%, children 50%, parents 12.5%.
programmes.source_snippet: Those with total disability receive AED 75,000 in compensation (GPSSA FAQ).

programmes.name_en: Abu Dhabi Pension Fund (ADPF) Retirement Benefits
programmes.amount_note: Pension for Emiratis employed in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi; contributions 26% of pensionable salary (11% employee, 15% employer) for new members.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: ADPF covers UAE nationals working in Abu Dhabi under a separate emirate-level pension system equivalent to the federal GPSSA scheme.

programmes.name_en: MoCE Social Welfare Programme (Monthly Social Assistance)
programmes.amount_note: Allowances: individual, spouse, child, job seeker/unemployment support, housing (families without government housing support), academic excellence (GPA 3.3+), seasonal and inflation allowances. Amounts depend on family composition and income; MoCE allowance calculator available.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online via the Ministry of Community Empowerment portal using UAE Pass

eligibility.income_note: No published number. The Ministry of Community Empowerment's own social welfare page (2026) says only that the total monthly family income must be below the eligibility threshold, without stating any AED figure; eligibility is determined case by case from the applicant's social and economic situation.

programmes.source_snippet: The Social Welfare Programme is a federal initiative implemented by Ministry of Community Empowerment (MoCE). It provides an integrated social safety net to Emirati families.

programmes.name_en: MoCE Inflation (Supplementary) Allowance
programmes.amount_note: Fuel: AED 300-900 per spouse; food: AED 500 per adult and AED 250 per child; electricity/water: AED 400 per month. Total family monthly income must be below AED 25,000. Paid on top of basic social welfare allowance.

eligibility.income_note: The UAE Government's official portal states the inflation allowance is for Emirati families whose total monthly income is less than AED 25,000 — AED 300,000/year. The allowance covers fuel, food and electricity/water cost increases and is paid on top of the basic social welfare allowance.

programmes.source_snippet: temporary support to mitigate the impact of rising living costs caused by global inflation

programmes.source_snippet: Apply for periodic social assistance - for nationals from Dubai - Community Development Authority.

Attend the mandatory awareness course within 12 months of applying

Not available to Qualifying Free Zone Persons or members of multinational groups with consolidated revenue above AED 3.15bn.

eligibility.income_note: Revenue must not exceed AED 3,000,000 in the relevant and previous tax periods

programmes.source_snippet: Revenue equal to or less than AED 3,000,000 in both the current and all previous Tax Periods

programmes.source_snippet: 0% rate on taxable income up to AED 375,000, with a 9% rate applying to income exceeding that threshold. Qualifying Free Zone Persons benefit from a 0% rate on their qualifying income.

programmes.source_snippet: The Wage Protection System ensures employees' wages are paid in full and on time through monitored electronic transfers.

programmes.name_local: دعم الدعاوى العمالية - وزارة الموارد البشرية
programmes.name_en: MOHRE Labour Claims and Dispute Resolution
programmes.funder: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)
programmes.amount_note: Free filing and mediation of labour complaints (unpaid wages, gratuity, arbitrary dismissal) via MOHRE, with referral to labour courts; claims up to AED 50,000 decided by MOHRE.

procedure_steps.detail: File a complaint via the MOHRE app, website or call centre 80060

programmes.source_snippet: Workers can file labour complaints free of charge with MOHRE for mediation and, where needed, referral to the labour courts.

programmes.name_en: Domestic Workers Law Protections
programmes.funder: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)
programmes.amount_note: Statutory protections for domestic workers: weekly rest, 30 days paid annual leave, sick leave, end-of-service gratuity and regulated recruitment via Tadbeer centres.
programmes.source_snippet: Federal law on domestic workers guarantees rest days, annual leave, sick leave and end-of-service benefits for household workers.

programmes.name_local: التأمين الصحي الإلزامي دبي - باقة المنافع الأساسية
programmes.name_en: Dubai Mandatory Health Insurance / Essential Benefits Plan (EBP)
programmes.funder: Dubai Health Authority (DHA) / employers and insurers
programmes.amount_note: Employers in Dubai must provide health insurance for employees; sponsors must insure their resident dependents. The AED 500-800 EBP premium figure is not published on the official page.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: In the emirate of Dubai, employers are required to provide health insurance coverage for their employees. Sponsors are required to get insurance cover for their resident dependents.

programmes.name_en: Abu Dhabi Mandatory Health Insurance (Daman Basic/Enhanced)
programmes.funder: Department of Health Abu Dhabi / employers and Daman
programmes.amount_note: In Abu Dhabi, employers and sponsors must provide health insurance for employees and their families (one spouse and three children under 18). Plan names and premiums are not stated on the official page.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: In the emirate of Abu Dhabi, employers and sponsors are responsible for the providing health insurance coverage for their employees and their families (1 spouse and 3 children under 18).

programmes.name_en: Nol Concession Cards (Students, Seniors, People of Determination) - Dubai RTA
programmes.amount_note: Blue personal nol card: 50% off Dubai metro and bus fares for students aged 5 to 23 enrolled in a UAE school/college/university and for senior Emiratis and residents aged 60+; People of Determination travel free on metro and buses. Concessions valid 1 year, renewable.

documents_required.doc: Enrolment letter (students) or People of Determination card

programmes.source_snippet: students aged 5 to 23 enrolled in a school, college, or university within the UAE; Senior Emiratis and residents aged 60 and above

programmes.name_en: Abu Dhabi Public Transport Concessions (Hafilat / DMT)
programmes.funder: Department of Municipalities and Transport - Abu Dhabi Mobility
programmes.amount_note: Concession Hafilat bus cards with free or reduced fares for senior citizens, People of Determination and students in Abu Dhabi.
programmes.source_snippet: Abu Dhabi's transport regulator issues concession Hafilat cards providing free or discounted bus travel to seniors, People of Determination and students.

programmes.name_local: إعفاء أصحاب الهمم من رسوم سالك
programmes.name_en: Salik Toll Exemption for People of Determination (Dubai)
programmes.amount_note: Exemption from Salik road tolls for one registered vehicle owned by a Person of Determination in Dubai.
programmes.source_snippet: The People of Determination are entitled of having Salik toll exemption of one vehicle and the exemption us renewed every year.

programmes.name_en: Free Parking Permits for People of Determination (Dubai RTA)
programmes.amount_note: Free parking permits at public parking for vehicles carrying People of Determination, issued by RTA Dubai.
programmes.source_snippet: free parking for the People of Determination

programmes.name_en: Shams Dubai (DEWA Distributed Solar Net Metering)
programmes.amount_note: Lets building owners install rooftop solar and offset electricity bills by exporting surplus power to the DEWA grid under net metering.
programmes.source_snippet: The electricity is used on site and the surplus is exported to DEWA's network.

programmes.name_local: تعرفة مخفضة للمواطنين - الاتحاد للماء والكهرباء
programmes.name_en: Etihad Water and Electricity Subsidised Tariff for UAE Nationals
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised water and electricity tariff slabs for UAE citizens' homes in the northern emirates (Sharjah, Ajman, RAK, Fujairah, UAQ).

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: EtihadWE applies subsidised utility tariff categories for UAE nationals' residential properties in the northern emirates.

programmes.name_en: ADDC/TAQA Subsidised Water and Electricity Tariff for Emiratis (Abu Dhabi)
programmes.funder: Abu Dhabi Distribution Company / TAQA Distribution
programmes.amount_note: Reduced residential water and electricity tariff slabs for UAE national account holders in Abu Dhabi.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: UAE nationals in Abu Dhabi are billed on subsidised residential electricity and water tariff slabs.

programmes.name_en: Esaad Privilege Card (Dubai Police)
programmes.amount_note: Free discount card for eligible Dubai residents (government employees, senior citizens, People of Determination, Golden Visa holders and other categories) covering retail, dining, healthcare, education and travel offers.
programmes.source_snippet: The Esaad card is a loyalty programme launched in March 2017 by the Dubai Police; cardholders are entitled to discounts and benefits.

programmes.name_en: Fazaa Card (Ministry of Interior Social Solidarity Fund)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Interior Social Solidarity Fund (Fazaa)
programmes.amount_note: Discount card for Ministry of Interior employees and registered member categories, covering retail, healthcare, education and services across the UAE.
programmes.source_snippet: Fazaa provides discounts and benefits to Ministry of Interior employees and eligible member groups across the UAE.

programmes.name_en: Thukher Card for Senior Emiratis (Dubai CDA)
programmes.amount_note: Privilege card for Dubai senior citizens (60+) offering discounts and priority services through the Thukher social club programme.
programmes.source_snippet: Thukher card is an electronic card issued to the seniors of the Emirate of Dubai who are over age of 60 years

programmes.name_en: People of Determination Card (Federal)
programmes.amount_note: ID card for people of determination (issued by Ministry of Community Empowerment, with local cards such as Sanad in Dubai) giving facilities in transport and other sectors, including toll exemptions and discounted public transport (varies by emirate).
programmes.source_snippet: The ID card offers many facilities and benefits in transport sector and others

programmes.name_en: Emirates Red Crescent Financial and Humanitarian Aid
programmes.amount_note: Case-by-case financial aid, medical-cost assistance and emergency relief for people in hardship in the UAE, including residents.
programmes.source_snippet: Emirates Red Crescent provides financial assistance and relief to individuals and families in hardship inside the UAE.

programmes.name_en: Dar Al Ber Society Assistance (Dubai)
programmes.amount_note: Licensed charity providing financial aid, rent and medical-bill support to low-income families and residents in Dubai.

eligibility.income_note: No published income threshold. Dar Al Ber Society's own site (2026) lists donation and sponsorship categories but publishes no income eligibility figure or means test for its family assistance; applications are assessed case by case.

programmes.source_snippet: Dar Al Ber Society assists low-income families and residents in Dubai with financial and in-kind aid.

programmes.name_en: Faraj Fund (Debt Relief for Insolvent Inmates and Families)
programmes.amount_note: Pays off debts of insolvent inmates detained for financial cases and supports their families, for citizens and residents.
programmes.source_snippet: Faraj Fund settles the debts of insolvent inmates in financial cases and supports their families in the UAE.

programmes.name_en: e& Swyp Youth Mobile Plan (Ages 18-25)
programmes.amount_note: Discounted mobile plans with bonus data and perks for customers aged 18-25 via the Swyp app.
programmes.source_snippet: Swyp is e&'s digital mobile plan for 18-25 year olds with discounted bundles and bonus benefits.

programmes.name_en: du Youth Plan (Ages 18-25)
programmes.amount_note: Discounted mobile plans and perks for customers aged 18-25.
programmes.source_snippet: du offers a youth plan with discounted bundles and benefits for customers aged 18 to 25.

programmes.name_en: Emirates Student Discount Fares
programmes.amount_note: Full-time students aged 16 to 31: up to 10% off Economy and up to 5% off Premium Economy/Business with code STUDENT, plus an extra 10kg or 1 extra baggage piece. Requires Emirates Skywards membership and a student ID or school acceptance letter at check-in.
programmes.source_snippet: Our offer is for full-time students between 16 and 31 years old.

programmes.name_en: ISIC International Student Identity Card (UAE)
programmes.amount_note: Internationally recognised student card giving UAE-enrolled students discounts on transport, software, food and attractions worldwide.
programmes.source_snippet: The ISIC card is the internationally accepted proof of student status, providing access to thousands of student discounts.
